## Findings (most severe first)
F1 MAJOR, same root class as r1 F2 (release cost superlinear), new lane. Each wave runs a full settle_cont_assigns_inner; every pass re-visits all ca_always (scan_arm.rs:835 / native run.rs:917) and all md groups (scan_arm.rs:883 / native 985). Release = O(waves x (|ca_always| + |md|)).
  r_chain N ($random callee -> uncertified held chain; ABBAABBA, warm-up dropped) B s 0.024/0.083/0.289 at N=250/500/1000 (x3.5 per doubling = quadratic); A 0.0064/0.0094/0.0145. B/A interp 3.7/8.8/19.9, native 3.2/7.8/19.2; AB and BA orders agree.
  sd_chain_1000_1000 (certified held chain 1000 + 1000 `assign #1`) B/A 2.23 interp / 2.40 native; sm_chain_1000_250 (+250 md nets) 1.80 / 1.41; s_chain_1000 alone 1.00 / 0.99. Values equal (t1 wN=0).
  Module doc "linear ... and so is the whole release" (t0_hold.rs:52-53) false when ca_always or md is non-empty. Real-design exposure UNVERIFIED.
  Candidate fix (re-measure, D7): by the closure no non-held assign reads a held net, so non-held ca_always members and md groups with no held member cannot change during the waves -> skip them in wave settles; release uncertified held assigns in one final wave (also closes F3; trade: a reverse-declared uncertified chain settles by passes, as on PRE2).
F2 MINOR, new instance (test teeth). MK1 and MKA survive --workspace 9119/9119; each puts back a call on a held net's declared default: MK1 r2e `gv t=0 v=z0`; MKA r2c `g3 t=0 x=z`. Pin r2e, r2c.
F3 MINOR, new instance, present since r1 (POSTA==POSTC). A declined callee's body reads are not in ca_deps' set (levelize/mod.rs:490-496), so the held assign is ordered without them: r2h2 POSTC `f2 t=0 x=1 w1=z`, `f1 t=0 x=0`, `f2 t=0 x=1 w1=0`; iverilog and verilator `f1 t=0 x=0`, `f2 t=0 x=1 w1=0`. PRE2 x-run (not a regression). Contradicts "never on the declared defaults".
F4 MINOR, cause UNVERIFIED. clk_200k (no call, hold inactive): interp B/A 1.045 (16 runs, AB 1.046, BA 1.045; first 8-run measure 1.05), native 0.983. pure_4000 1.00/0.99.

cells (12, newcells/): r2a 2 held drivers on one wire + reader declared first · r2b held + non-held driver · r2c {p,q}=h(a) with 2-level reverse downstream of q (MKA killer) · r2d reader of 2 held nets from different waves · r2e sole held driver reading its own net + reverse reader (MK1 killer) · r2f 3 held drivers, 2 in one wave, last reads the net · r2g independent chain + shared-net cycle + downstream · r2h/r2h2 declined callee reads a held net in its BODY (module write / $random) · r2i uncertified held chain x6 · r2j $fatal latched in a release wave + downstream wave · r2z nothing held, VCD.

## Q1-Q3 source census (post_c tree s590/wt; t0_hold.rs line = diff line - 1986)
Q1 termination: closure queue gets a CA only as a seed (t0_hold.rs:171) or on held false->true (185-189): <= nca pushes. next_wave: None iff pending==0 (279); every Some wave is non-empty, pending strictly falls (293). Invariant pending == #unreleased: a CA enters `next` only when its unsat hits 0 (330-332), once, while unreleased (gain filters !released 312/320); initial-ready CAs have no counted pair so get no decrement. Release loop <= #held iterations; an inner settle at the delta limit returns None through `?` (run ends DeltaLimit; finish() skipped, harmless).
Q1 determinism: only BTreeMap (readers_of 177, nets 198) / BTreeSet (x_drop before; func_effect_free, body_has_systask) / Vec; wave sorted (289); 0 HashMap/HashSet in t0_hold.rs (grep). Measured: det.py 3 runs x 3 backends.
Q1 in-degree: counted pair (r,n) = n in r's read set with a held driver other than r (224). Exactly one decrement per counted pair: r not driving n -> at rem==0 (318-326, once); r driving n (rem_init>=2) -> at rem==1 when r is the last unprocessed driver (311-317, once; if r is in the same wave, find(!released) yields none). Multi-net CA: drives deduped (206-207). Multi-driver net: rem = distinct held drivers (214-215). No uncounted decrement (driver readers excluded at rem==0 by released+binary_search 320-321; rem==1 needs readers.contains(d) and rem_init>=2) -> no u32 underflow at 330.
Q1 cycle fallback (284-296): ready empty, pending>0 -> all unreleased released at once, no bookkeeping, pending -> 0. Remainder = cycle members + everything downstream (identity vs post_a: implementer probe, not re-measured).
Q1 release marks dirty: engine t0_hold.rs:444-450 (flag+push), native run.rs:774-779 (insert). Each held CA is in exactly one wave -> marked once. Before it: dropped from every pass without re-dirty (414-435 / native 791-816); md groups with a held member skipped (scan_arm.rs:883 / native 985-989); delayed scheduling (scan_arm.rs:980) and copy repair (scan_arm.rs:1330 / native 1183) skip held. begin_release: run_loop.rs:143,259 / native 368,466; release_due checked in both wrappers (scan_arm.rs:762 / native 762); *_inner called only by wrapper + release (grep). Run ending inside the first batch never releases (r1 sd02a/b final y=z = iverilog).
Q1 premise: ca_deps read set = rhs nets + lvalue index nets + callee BODY reads only for calls expr_call_reads accepts (levelize/mod.rs:490-496 "for a certified call"). Declined callee -> seed, so the closure is complete, but its wave order misses body reads -> r2h/r2h2.
Q2 nothing held (active=false): per settle call release_due (2 loads, scan_arm.rs:762 / native 762); per inner settle 1 load; per pass `if holding`; per md group per pass `holding &&`; held_now per delayed CA in delayed scheduling (short-circuit on active); native loop top +1 check_call_fatal (Cell<bool> load). Build: no Call -> one O(#exprs) scan; calls present -> `reached` Vec per CA + func_effect_free re-running func_read_deps even when nothing ends held ("nothing is allocated" is true of the stored state only). Measured: clk_200k, pure_4000.
Q3: native run.rs:396-419 == run_loop.rs:178-203 in order (spawned -> check -> settle {None: DeltaLimit, Some(true): propagate} -> check). Bodies equal (run_loop.rs:649-657 vs native run.rs:390-398: finished, had_fatal, drain_deferred_on_finish, flush_postponed). Engine's in-batch checks (run_loop.rs:273, 288) are outside this delta, not compared.
